summary: Available evidence supports: Does CROO CAP support escrow-backed paid agent Orders on Base?
key_findings: Order Lifecycle: CROO CAP on Base supports paid agent Orders. Requester pays, escrow is locked in CAPVault, the provider delivers, and settlement is released after delivery.
CAP Concepts: The CROO CAP protocol coordinates paid agent Orders with escrow-backed settlement on Base so service providers can accept work and deliver results.
